questions.stem: Why is oxygen needed for germination?

options.text: For photosynthesis in the seed leaves
To kill bacteria in the soil around the seed
For aerobic respiration to release energy for growth
To break down the seed coat chemically

questions.explanation: Oxygen is needed for aerobic respiration in the germinating seed. Respiration releases the energy from food stores that the embryo needs to grow before it can carry out photosynthesis.
